text: dsh-git-nexus 是 DSH Web 插件，在会话标题栏加入 Git 管理面板。面板可查看工作区变更与 diff、暂存和提交、切换与管理分支、推送或拉取代码，并浏览仓库文件、查看提交记录和维护工作步骤；GitHub 面板支持设备授权和创建 Pull Request。适合希望在 DSH Web 会话中处理常见 Git 操作并跟踪计划的开发者。使用 GitHub 功能需登录 GitHub，可用 OAuth App Client ID 或已认证的 gh CLI；OAuth 流程会连接 GitHub 服务。

dsh-git-nexus adds a Git panel to DSH Web sessions. Review diffs, stage and commit files, manage branches, and push or pull code. Browse project files, view commit history, and track workflow steps. GitHub login and pull request creation need an OAuth App Client ID or authenticated gh CLI.
想在 DSH 网页会话里暂存改动、写提交并查看 diff。
DSH 里能不能直接切分支、看最近的提交记录？
I want to browse and open project files without leaving my DSH session.
dsh-git-nexus 的功能「Git 变更与提交」：在会话头部面板中查看工作区状态和文件 diff，选择暂存、取消暂存或提交改动，也可执行 push、pull、sync 和 fetch。
dsh-git-nexus 的功能「仓库浏览与工作步骤」：打开 Files 标签搜索仓库文件并查看文本内容，也可在 Workflow 标签添加步骤、循环切换待办状态或删除步骤。
dsh-git-nexus 使用 GitHub 功能时会连接 api.github.com；OAuth 登录会向 github.com 设备授权端点提交客户端 ID 和授权请求，并轮询令牌端点。
dsh-git-nexus 的 OAuth 登录需要 GitHub OAuth App Client ID；授权后的令牌保存在本机设置文件中。

dsh-git-nexus README · dsh-git-nexus：A single, self-contained DeepSeek Harness (DSH) **web** plugin that merges the
git-management features of the popular `dsh-web-ui` plugin (SCM change panel +
branch management) with GitHub access, a workflow board, and file browsing —
one panel instead of several plugins.

dsh-git-nexus README · Features：- **Changes (SCM)** — working-tree status, per-file diff, stage / unstage / discard, commit.
- **Branches** — list, switch, create, delete.
- **Remote** — push, pull, sync (pull then push), fetch.
- **Log** — bounded, structured commit history.
- **Files** — list tracked files with search, read any text file.
- **Workflow** — persistent step board (Claude Code-style plan tracking).
- **GitHub** — OAuth Device Flow login (full `repo` access, revocable), scope seal, PR creation.

dsh-git-nexus README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-git-nexus"

dsh-git-nexus README · then restart the web profile：dsh web
```

The plugin appears under **Settings → Plugins** and the panel pill appears in
the session header of git-managed workspaces.

dsh-git-nexus README · Compatibility：Targets DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` (web profile). The plugin ships a strict
[Typert](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) host manifest
(`./typert`) and mounts strict client codecs, matching the conventions of the
plugins inside the official repository.

dsh-git-nexus README · Compatibility：This is a **community plugin** published under the [`dsh-plugin`
topic](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) — the channel the DeepSeek Harness
maintainers ask community extensions to use (see the project's
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)).

dsh-git-nexus README · GitHub OAuth：GitHub auth uses the [device flow](https://docs.github.com/en/apps/oauth-apps/building-oauth-apps/authorizing-oauth-apps#device-flow),
so no long-lived PAT is written to disk. You need a GitHub **OAuth App client id**:

dsh-git-nexus README · GitHub OAuth：1. Go to GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps → New OAuth App.
2. Any name / homepage / callback will do (device flow ignores the callback).
3. Paste the resulting **Client ID** into the panel's GitHub tab, click **Connect**,
   then open the printed URL and enter the user code.

dsh-git-nexus README · GitHub OAuth：The resulting token requests the `repo`, `workflow`, `read:user` and `user:email`
scopes and is stored with `0600` permissions under
`~/.dsh/storages/dsh-git-nexus/`. If the `gh` CLI is already authenticated, the
plugin uses it automatically and no client id is required.

dsh-git-nexus README · Security notes：- Every git/file command runs through a fresh `/bin/sh -c` child process with a
  30s timeout and a 2 MiB output cap. The web profile scopes DSH's `shell`
  service to per-session agent realms, so the host-plane gateway executes
  directly instead of injecting it.
- Branch names, paths, and commit messages are shell-quoted; control characters are rejected.
- GitHub tokens live only under `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-git-nexus/settings.json` (mode `0600`).
